name: Baton Rouge Winter A 2025
information: This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing LLC](southerncubing.com). To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com. - Please review the [competitor information] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BatonRougeWinterA2025#45661-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BatonRougeWinterA2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
